main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 3-bar return after Sunday falls

statistic.name: ordinary t of the mean of forecast-scaled excess returns

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and slope > 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: least-squares slope of excess 3-bar return on forecast > 0

decided_by: Confirm: weighted mean excess 3-bar return above 0 with t >= 2 and a positive slope on the forecast.
reading: Every Sunday bar (UTC start on Sunday) in regime mean_reversion with forecast >= 2 and three later bars in its window is one case (Sundays are 7 bars apart, so their 3-bar returns never overlap), and the coin's drift is the mean of its 3-bar returns on the grid 0, 3, 6, ... of each window, pooled over all its windows.
